scope: CPU microbenchmark, 10000 unchanged readings per case; no GPU claim
command: godot --headless --path PROJECT --script /absolute/current/tests/benchmark_hud_refresh.gd (same script for both projects)
notes: Alternating baseline/current runs; microbench timings vary with concurrent workers.

Source label fitting invalidates on text, font/theme, size, extent and wrap changes.
